stem.text: Which description lists all the components of a human haemoglobin molecule?

A.text: four polypeptides that are all the same and one haem group

B.text: four polypeptides that are **not** all the same and one haem group

C.text: four polypeptides that are all the same and four haem groups

D.text: four polypeptides that are **not** all the same and four haem groups
